MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING
  APRIL 24, 2024
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  6:00 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Uhring called the meeting to order at 6:05 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Steve Uhring; Mayor Pro Tem Doug Stewart; and Councilmembers
  Paul Grisanti, Marianne Riggins, and Bruce Silverstein

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Steve McClary, City Manager;
  Joseph Toney, Assistant City Manager; Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk; Kristin Riesgo,
  Community Services Director; Yolanda Bundy, Environmental Sustainability Director;
  Richard Mollica, Planning Director; Susan Duefias, Public Safety Director; Rob DuBoux,
  Public Works Director; Parker Davis, Media Technician; Renee Neermann, Finance
  Manager; Tracey Rossine, Environmental Programs Manager; Raneika Brooks, Senior
  Planner; Rebecca Evans, Senior Administrative Analyst; Adrian Fernandez, Assistant
  Planning Director; and Brandie Ayala, Administrative Analyst

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Councilmember Grisanti led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on April
  19, 2024.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Grisanti moved, and Mayor Pro Tem Stewart seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Proposed Budget for Fiscal Year 2024-25
  Recommended Action: Provide direction and feedback to staff on the Fiscal Year
  (FY) 2024-25 Proposed Budget.

  City Manager McClary announced the City received an award for the Building
  Department of the Year Award from the California Building Officials Association.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of April 24, 2024
  Page 2 of 3

Assistant City Manager Toney presented a portion of the staff report and the
Management and Administrative Services budget.

The Council directed questions to staff.

Mayor Uhring opened the floor for public comment.

Speakers: Ryan Embree, and Jo Drummond

As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Uhring returned the matter to the
table for discussion.

City Clerk Pettij ohn presented the City Clerk Department budget.

The Council directed questions to staff.

Public Safety Director Dueflas presented the Public Safety Department budget.

The Council directed questions to staff.

Community Services Director Riesgo presented the Community Services
Department budget.

The Council directed questions to staff.

Environmental Sustainability Director Bundy presented the Environmental
Sustainability Department budget.

The Council directed questions to staff.

Flaming Director Mollica presented the Planning Department budget.

The Council directed questions to staff.

Public Works Director DuBoux presented the Public Works Department budget.

The Council discussed the Capital Improvement Proj ects and directed questions to
staff.

Assistant City Manager Toney presented the staff report.

The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of April 24, 2024
  Page 3 of 3

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Uhring adjourned the meeting at 8:28 pm.
